text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #898781

g.text: produces about half the first. Below freezing recovery is suppressed

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #898781

g.text: entirely, so the ground stays wet and the second storm produces more

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #898781

g.text: than the first. The linear model with a zero recovery rate abstracts

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #898781

g.text: both storms and reports no RDII at all.
